items.intro_words: Roll call, please. Evelyn. Trustee Weekley.
Welcome by the School Board President, Cecilia Márquez
And are there any changes to the agenda?
And are there any changes to the agenda? Yes
With that, if there's no other changes to the agenda, can I please get a motion to approve it?
Okay, so item 13.1 has been moved up to oral communication. And this is recognition of classified employees.
Great with that then. Item 6.2, Approval of Measure T bond program tracking list of items under 20,000.
6.3, approval of proposal for the furnishing and installation of the water pump with Scapes Incorporated
And then bond program action items 7.1, approval of measure T final projects list.
7.2. Approval of amendment number two to the Program Management Services Agreement with RGMK.
Okay, so item 8, school and community reports.
8.1. School plans for student achievement reports for Garfield Community School and Henry Ford.
So moving along then, we're on to item nine, discussion items.
And action. Item 11.1, approval of recruitment incentive stipend for hard to fill middle school, special education
Next. Item 11.2, Adoption of Resolution 32 authorizing the establishment of a bank clearing account.
